returns.jurors: Array of all registered juror addresses

registerJuror().details: Anyone can call if they meet the reputation requirement

selectJury(uint256,uint256,address[]).details: Only callable by the authorized challenge contract.      Uses prevrandao + challengeId as entropy source.      Selection is weighted by reputation (higher rep = higher probability).

params.excludes: Addresses to exclude from selection (challenger, submitter)
params.jurySize: Number of jurors to select (3, 7, or 11)

unregisterJuror().details: Removes juror from pool. Can be called anytime by the juror.

CARTEL_RESISTANCE_FACTOR().notice: Cartel resistance multiplier: pool must have >= jurySize * factor eligible jurors.         With factor=3 and jurySize=7, a cartel controlling 4/7 seats needs to own         4 of 21 registered jurors (19%), making coordinated pool capture far more         expensive than simply meeting the minimum pool requirement.         Without this guard, a cartel needs only jurySize+1 jurors to guarantee majority.

MIN_JUROR_REP().notice: Minimum reputation required to register as a juror

challengeContract().notice: Authorized challenge contract that can select juries

constructor.notice: Deploy the jury pool linked to reputation contract

deployer().notice: Deployer, used only to set challenge contract once

getJurorCount().notice: Get the number of registered jurors

isEligible(address).notice: Check if an address is eligible to be a juror

isRegistered(address).notice: Check if an address is registered as a juror

registerJuror().notice: Register as a juror (must have reputation >= MIN_JUROR_REP)

registeredJurors(address).notice: Whether an address is registered as a juror

selectJury(uint256,uint256,address[]).notice: Select a jury for a challenge using weighted random selection

setChallengeContract(address).notice: Set the challenge contract that can select juries. Set once only.
